propositions: transport.py chronically hits the 800-line cap because new capabilities default to the monolith rather than having determined homes, forcing repeated rescue splits
previous extractions (retry.py, transitions.py) were reactive and re-exported as facade, so they did not establish where new code should go
the module's natural boundaries already exist as capability Protocols (_backend.py), but the implementation is not organized along those seams

transport.py must be split into capability-aligned mixins (_base, _issues, _hierarchy, _links, _people, properties/comments) so future operations have a determined home based on which Protocol they implement
the refactor is a pure relocation: JiraDataCenterTransport remains one class satisfying the same Protocols, all tests pass unedited, and all resulting modules stay in the 100-500 LOC band
_resolve_epic_link_field_id must have exactly one definition across the split to avoid reintroducing duplication that ticket 9bb9 deliberately addressed
